Our Assets

Current Portfolio Assets

34 MW of operational photovoltaic parks across southern Italy — the foundation of our sustainable investment strategy.

Our initial portfolio comprises approximately 34 MW of PV parks strategically located in southern Italy, specifically across the regions of Puglia, Basilicata and Campania. These installations represent our commitment to sustainable energy generation and form the foundation of our impactful investment strategy.

Each asset has been selected through our rigorous due diligence process, evaluated for technical performance, grid connection quality, irradiation levels, and long-term operational stability.

Locations

Southern Italy's
Solar Potential

Puglia, Basilicata and Campania represent three of Italy's highest-irradiation regions, with solar resource levels that rank among the best in continental Europe. Our strategic asset selection in these regions was driven by superior energy yield potential, robust grid infrastructure, and a favourable regulatory environment.

These characteristics translate directly into performance stability and predictable long-term returns for our partners.
